sequences.name: Warrior (Divine Blood Warrior, Beyonder Warrior)
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Supernatural strength and agility that greatly transcends non-Beyonders.
Combat Mastery (Weapon, Armor, Martial Arts): Mastery of all kinds of Weapons and Armor; no Weapon they can't use. Mastery of all forms of Combat and Martial Arts.

sequences.name: Pugilist (Gladiator)
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Physical abilities can weaken the effects of some Beyonder powers.
Supernatural Resistance: Experts in Combat that can use their bodies to mitigate the effects of certain supernatural forces.
Combat Mastery (Close Combat): More adept at close-quarters Combat than any other Sequence.

sequences.name: Weapon Master
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Superhuman strength, physique, and agility.
Weapon Mastery: Can use any Weapon at a master-level standard, including Beyonder Weapons, Mystical Items, and Sealed Artifacts.

sequences.name: Dawn Paladin
abilities: Strength of Giants: Giant-like strength, powerful offensive capability, and relatively high defense.
Light of Dawn (Sunrise Gleam): Can fill an area with pure, Sacred Dawn Light that dispels Illusions, Exorcises Wraiths and Shadows, and weakens Evil Spirits.
Dawn Armor: Can conjure a silver Armor of Dawn that is equivalent to refined full-body armor.
Sword of Dawn: Can condense Dawn into Weapons, strongest of which is a two-handed Sword of Dawn.
Hurricane of Light: Most powerful attack; creates countless fragments of Dawn-like light forming a violently sharp Hurricane filled with destructive power.

sequences.name: Guardian
abilities: Strength of Giants: Defense and strength is like an adult compared to a child.
Protection: Rarely injured; can create indestructible invisible walls to Protect companions.
Illusion Immunity: Can't be deceived by Illusions.
Supernatural Resistance: Enhanced; can slow down having their Spirit Body Threads controlled.

sequences.name: Demon Hunter (Witcher)
abilities: Physical & Mental Enhancement: Terrifying Physical strength and a Mind between God and human.
Spirituality: Significantly enhanced Spirituality; strong Spiritual Intuition.
Eye of Demon Hunting: Can identify a target's nature, weaknesses, condition, and whether they are Corrupted or Possessed.
Knowledge (Hunting, Alchemy): Adept at dealing with all kinds of situations; knowledge of monster parts and herbs.
Mind Concealment: Can Conceal actions and intentions, effectively interfering with Divination and Prophecy.
Protection: Enhanced; can create invisible and indestructible wall of defense.
Light of Dawn: Can be condensed into objects other than weapons.
Mythical Creature Form: Incomplete Cyclops.

sequences.name: Silver Knight
abilities: Mercury Liquefaction: Can melt into a malleable silvery metallic liquid to restrict enemies and evade attacks.
Silver Rapier: Can condense silvery white beams of light that tear apart everything and can Teleport.
Light Concealment: Can utilize any light source as a way of dodging, evasion, and movement.
Silver Armor: Full-body Silver Armor much stronger than a Giant Dragon in terms of withstanding blows.
Sword of Dawn: Can permanently materialize their Sword of Dawn.
Hurricane of Light: Can ignite their body with a transparent flame, creating a terrifying Hurricane of Light.
Combat Mastery (Direct Combat): Extremely skilled in direct Combat.
Physical Enhancement: Greatly enhanced physical strength and speed.
Mythical Creature Form: Nearly 6 meter tall Cyclops.

sequences.name: Glory
sequences.description: The three authorities of the Twilight Giant Pathway's Sequence 0—Holiness, Twilight, and Combat—are all manifested at this stage. For Angels, this is a kind of Glory.
abilities: Strength of Giants: Can grow to an enormous size.
Twilight: Hold simplified authority of Twilight; can age themselves rapidly and be reborn in the Spirit World.
Combat: Hold simplified Combat authority; top Sequence 2 in frontal combat.
Protection: Can form a Cage that also gains a Sealing effect.
Twilight Sword: Can instantly condense a great sword composed of orange-red Twilight radiance.
Hurricane of Light: Can transform the Hurricane of Light into an orange-red storm capable of annihilating a wasteland.
Holiness: Hold simplified authority of Holiness.
Mythical Creature Form: Complete 12-meter tall Cyclops.

sequences.name: Hand of God
abilities: Proxy: Can act on behalf of the Deity to manifest divine power and punishment.
Combat: Enhanced corresponding abilities to the Combat authority.
Protection: Can summon Cages made of dense light that can prevent even Observers or Dimensional Shadows from crossing.

sequences.name: Twilight Giant (Twilight, Giant)
sequences.description: They hold partial authority over Holiness, Twilight, and Combat (which contains subordinate authorities like Strength, Gigantism, Devastation, and Protection) as well as a portion of the Proxy authority.
abilities: Twilight: Can cause Matter, will, and the void to Decay, collapse, and vanish.
Land of Twilight: Divine Kingdom formed through Twilight, completely frozen within the Passage of Time.
Dawn: Authority of Dawn; can directly Purify a Beyonder Characteristic.
Holiness: Partial authority over Holiness; excels in Purification and discerning Evil and Corruption.
Combat: Authority of Combat; can strip opponents of Skill, forcing them to fight by instinct alone.
Proxy: Portion of the Proxy authority.
